about.title: Running & Endurance Coach
about.bio: I coach runners of all levels — from first 5K finishers to experienced marathoners chasing personal records. My approach combines structured training, running form analysis, and the mental skills that make the difference in the final miles of any race.

hero.headline: Run Faster. Run Farther. Run Smart.
hero.subline: Personal running coaching — race training plans, running form analysis, and endurance development for runners ready to hit their next goal.

packages.title: 5K / 10K Program
packages.description: 8-week structured training plan — base building, tempo work, interval training, and race-day strategy for runners targeting their first or fastest 5K or 10K.

packages.title: Half / Full Marathon Plan
packages.description: 16-week comprehensive marathon training program — long run progressions, quality workouts, recovery management, and race strategy built for your specific goal time.

packages.title: Speed Development Sessions
packages.description: Individual running form analysis and speed-focused session blocks for runners who want to get faster — mechanics, turnover, and track workouts with direct coaching.

faq.question: Do I need to be an experienced runner to work with you?
faq.answer: No — I coach everyone from first-time 5K runners to competitive masters athletes. Programs always start with where you are, not where I expect you to be.

faq.question: Is the coaching done in-person or remote?
faq.answer: Both options are available. Remote coaching includes a weekly training plan, check-in calls, and video form analysis. In-person sessions are held on local tracks and trails.

faq.question: How do you build a training plan?
faq.answer: Every plan starts with your current mileage, race goal, timeline, and schedule. Plans are adjusted weekly based on how your body is responding.

faq.question: Do you provide nutrition guidance?
faq.answer: Yes — I provide endurance-specific fueling guidance including pre-run nutrition, mid-run fueling strategy, and recovery nutrition basics.

faq.question: Can you coach injured runners?
faq.answer: With medical clearance, yes. I modify training plans to protect healing tissue while maintaining fitness where possible.
